'''Yarden Bond''' is an [[Engineers|Odyssey Engineer]] based at '''Salamander Bank''' in the '''Bayan''' system. She specialises in suit mobility and stealth alongside weapon-handling and sound modifications.<ref name="inara-yarden">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/33/ Yarden Bond — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 12 September 2026.</ref><ref name="edwiki-yarden">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Yarden_Bond Yarden Bond], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 12 September 2026.</ref>

== Location ==

Yarden's workshop is at '''Salamander Bank''', a surface Engineer base on '''Bayan 7 b''' in the '''Bayan''' system. The body is approximately 700 light-seconds from the system arrival point.<ref name="inara-salamander">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/366283/ Salamander Bank — Station], INARA. Accessed 12 September 2026.</ref>

No system permit is required.

== Discovery and access ==

=== Prerequisite ===

Yarden is discovered through [[Kit Fowler]]. After unlocking Kit, provide him with '''5 Surveillance Equipment''' to receive Yarden's referral.<ref name="inara-kit">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/29/ Kit Fowler — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 12 September 2026.</ref>

That delivery is Kit's referral requirement. It is separate from Yarden's own workshop unlock.

=== Workshop unlock ===

After receiving the referral, sell '''5 Smear Campaign Plans''' to bartenders.<ref name="inara-yarden" />

Frontier reduced this requirement from eight plans to five in Update 18.08.<ref name="frontier-1808">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/update-notes/4-0-18-08 Update 18.08], Frontier Developments, 6 February 2024. Accessed 12 September 2026.</ref>

Station services may not appear immediately after the unlock completes. If necessary, return to the main menu and re-enter the game.<ref name="inara-yarden" />

== Services ==

Yarden installs three suit modifications and three handheld-weapon modifications.<ref name="inara-yarden" />

=== Suit modifications ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Modification
! Function
|-
| Combat Movement Speed
| Removes the normal movement-speed penalty while aiming down sights.
|-
| Improved Jump Assist
| Extends the duration of the suit's Jump Assist thrust.
|-
| Quieter Footsteps
| Reduces the distance from which footsteps can be heard.
|}

=== Weapon modifications ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Modification
! Function
|-
| Audio Masking
| Reduces a weapon's simulated sound in unpressurised environments.
|-
| Faster Handling
| Improves weapon draw, stow, and handling speed.
|-
| Improved Hip Fire Accuracy
| Improves accuracy when firing without aiming down sights.
|}

{{Field note|Yarden can provide both halves of an unpressurised stealth loadout: Quieter Footsteps for movement noise and Audio Masking for weapon noise. Noise Suppressor is the related weapon modification intended for pressurised interiors.}}

Suit and handheld-weapon modifications are permanent once installed. The equipment must have an unused modification slot, and the required Odyssey materials and credits are paid at the workshop. See [[Odyssey Engineering]] for equipment grades, modification slots, material handling, and the installation process.

== Reputation and progression ==

Odyssey Engineers do not use the Grade 1–5 workshop-reputation system used by ship Engineers. Once Yarden is unlocked, her available modifications can be installed immediately when the equipment and material requirements are met.

Yarden does not provide a direct referral to another Engineer.<ref name="inara-yarden" />
